# mxr

> A local mail runtime for you and your agents. mxr syncs connected mail
> into a local mailbox and exposes shared daemon-backed state to human and
> machine clients. Client operations and authority vary by path. Local search
> and cached-mail reads use that state; sync,
> sends, provider-backed changes, uncached attachments, and configured model
> endpoints can still use the network. Pronounced "Mixer".

## Getting started

- [Quick start](https://mxr.sh/getting-started/quick-start.md): inspect synthetic mail locally, choose a client, then connect your own account
- [Use mxr with an existing agent](https://mxr.sh/getting-started/agent-quick-start.md): local Codex MCP or CLI skill, synthetic mail, shared draft review
- [Installation](https://mxr.sh/getting-started/install.md): Homebrew, cargo, or pre-built binaries
- [Gmail setup](https://mxr.sh/getting-started/gmail-setup.md): OAuth flow plus SSH-friendly fallbacks
- [IMAP / SMTP setup](https://mxr.sh/getting-started/imap-smtp-setup.md): Fastmail, Migadu, ProtonMail Bridge, Outlook, Yahoo, self-hosted
- [First sync](https://mxr.sh/getting-started/first-sync.md): from installed binary to a working local mailbox

## Reference

- [CLI overview](https://mxr.sh/reference/cli/index.md): every subcommand, auto-generated from `--help` snapshots
- [CLI concepts](https://mxr.sh/reference/cli/concepts.md): query operators, search modes, output formats, IPC buckets
- [JSON output schemas](https://mxr.sh/reference/json-output.md): canonical field names returned by `mxr ... --format json`
- [Keybindings](https://mxr.sh/reference/keybindings.md): default TUI bindings; vim-native nav + Gmail email actions
- [TUI](https://mxr.sh/reference/tui.md): seven top-level screens, lenses, modals, panes
- [Desk and places](https://mxr.sh/reference/desk-and-places.md): desk lanes, Done, placement rules for Reading and Paper trail, JSON output
- [Time phrases](https://mxr.sh/reference/time-phrases.md): every time phrase mxr accepts and how it resolves
- [Config](https://mxr.sh/reference/config.md): TOML schema for ~/.config/mxr/config.toml + custom keybindings
- [HTTP bridge](https://mxr.sh/reference/bridge.md): endpoints, auth, curl recipes
- [API route inventory](https://mxr.sh/reference/api-explorer/): read-only list of the daemon HTTP routes in the generated OpenAPI document; some live routes are missing (requires JS)

## Work with your mail

- [Work through your day](https://mxr.sh/guides/your-day.md): start on Now, then reply in Messages, act on To do, review Updates, read newsletters and retrieve sourced records
- [Start from Now](https://mxr.sh/guides/now.md): choose from a short list across five modes; finish each item in its own mode
- [Email modes](https://mxr.sh/guides/email-modes.md): five workflows over one mailbox, with separate completion actions; Inbox remains an arrival-order view
- [Messages](https://mxr.sh/guides/messages.md): conversations with people, their source messages and reply actions
- [To do](https://mxr.sh/guides/todo.md): dated actions tied to source email and reviewed before completion
- [Updates](https://mxr.sh/guides/updates.md): notifications grouped by source; inspect the source email or create a task when needed
- [Reading](https://mxr.sh/guides/reading.md): read chosen newsletters as an edition and keep items in Later
- [Archive](https://mxr.sh/guides/archive.md): retrieve a sourced fact and open its supporting email or document; records do not archive provider mail
- [Reply to everyone you owe](https://mxr.sh/guides/focus-and-reply.md): focus workflow, undo send, promises on send, `mxr commitments add`
- [Reading and Paper trail](https://mxr.sh/guides/reading-and-paper-trail.md): compatibility guide to the older Paper trail sender-bundle view and its commands

## Working with mxr

- [Recipes](https://mxr.sh/guides/recipes.md): pipelines combining mxr with fzf, jq, xargs, watch, cron, $EDITOR
- [Triage flow](https://mxr.sh/guides/triage-flow.md): the canonical inbox-zero loop
- [Search workflow](https://mxr.sh/guides/search.md): saved searches, query operators, hybrid retrieval
- [Compose](https://mxr.sh/guides/compose.md): `$EDITOR` workflow with markdown + YAML frontmatter
- [Rules](https://mxr.sh/guides/rules.md): deterministic filing, dry-run before commit
- [Sender view](https://mxr.sh/guides/sender-view.md): per-sender relationship aggregates
- [Snippets](https://mxr.sh/guides/snippets.md): `;name` expansion in compose
- [Analytics](https://mxr.sh/guides/analytics.md): storage, contacts, stale, response-time, subscriptions, Wrapped

## Agents and automation

- [For agents](https://mxr.sh/guides/for-agents.md): use local mail through CLI or first-party MCP; external agent models, account scope, and request-origin authority boundaries
- [LLM features](https://mxr.sh/guides/llm-features.md): configure mxr-native features separately from an external agent model; per-feature overrides, destinations, and planned mode tiers
- [Agent skill](https://mxr.sh/guides/agent-skill.md): install paths for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Continue, Aider, and custom prompts
- [Automation contract](https://mxr.sh/guides/automation-contract.md): which commands return JSON, which support `--dry-run`, which accept piped IDs

## Concepts

- [Why mxr](https://mxr.sh/guides/why-mxr.md): why a shared local mail runtime complements an agent's provider connector
- [Architecture](https://mxr.sh/guides/architecture.md): daemon-backed, provider-agnostic, IPC bucket model
- [Glossary](https://mxr.sh/guides/glossary.md): plain-language definitions of the terms scattered across docs
- [Security & privacy](https://mxr.sh/guides/security-and-privacy.md): what stays local, what doesn't
